name: 99567 · Chugiak, AK
findings: ZIP 99567 (Chugiak) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99567 (Chugiak) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 99567 (Chugiak) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
